title: Paperclip Island acceptance evidence package schema
description: Non-product design document. This schema contains no test results and grants no authority. M0 is mock-data-only; product implementation, macOS execution and notifications require separate explicit approval. Real credentials and APIs are M1-only and separately authorized. Mock green does not establish compilation, signing, native capture, device acceptance, or real API success. Missing experiments remain not_run or blocked; skipped is never pass.
$comment: Draft 2020-12 structural constraints only. Before accepting an instance, separately verify original authorization, SHA256 values against delivered bytes, spec/acceptance version agreement, full source reproducibility and untracked-file coverage, ID uniqueness by field, every artifact/command/check/actor reference, command exit assertions and timestamps, actor identity independence, reviewer scope and reviewed-source equality, gate-to-check category/status agreement, and complete acceptance-ID coverage. format may be annotation-only: use a validator with date-time format checking. No generated sample evidence or placeholder digest is valid evidence. JSON parsing alone is not JSON Schema conformance validation or product acceptance.

source.description: Bind the exact tested source. commit/tree/base are full Git object IDs; tree is the committed tree. diff_sha256 hashes the exact archived binary-capable diff bytes against base, including tracked working-tree changes. Archive and hash every untracked file separately. No repository or unobserved value may be invented. Cross-reference and recompute hashes in semantic review.

environment.description: Record observed build/run OS, architecture, and exact toolchain versions. Null means unavailable, not a guessed target. Explain unknown or untested environment attributes in limitations; hardware IDs must not expose private identifiers.

items.description: This is a pointer to already-existing explicit user authorization, not permission granted by the evidence author. Verify identity, wording, scope, and time against the original source.

gates.description: Every gate remains visible, including future gates. not_applicable requires a concrete scope reason and cannot satisfy a required gate. Native/real gates without an actual authorized experiment are not_run or blocked, never inferred from a mock green result.

command.description: Record the exact command and exit code. Never put secrets in command text or logs. A command that never started has null times and exit code; its reason is not execution output. A nonzero expected exit is allowed only when the linked check documents that assertion.

artifact.description: Hash the exact delivered bytes, after any privacy redaction; record what redaction limits. A mock image is not a native screenshot. No credentials or tokens may appear in evidence. Semantic review checks size, hash, provenance, retention, and local reference resolution.
